changelog:
Initial release: automated Darwinian-style idea evolution and ranking system.

- Imports raw ideas from ideas.md and structures them into individually scored idea cards.
- Runs iterative rounds of deepening, derivation, crossbreeding, critique, and validation to evolve ideas.
- Maintains a transparent scoring system across six weighted dimensions and three-layer composite scores.
- Supports commands for initialization, iteration, status, and idea management (dormant/wake).
- Creates project structure with config, cards, round reports, leaderboard, stimuli entries, and relationship graph.
- Triggers automatically for brainstorming and idea selection tasks, even without explicit command.
